remarks: Exquisite, turnkey 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom residence located on the first floor of an elegant, full-service doorman building in the heart of downtown Greenwich. This beautifully renovated 1,250 sq ft home offers a seamless blend of sophistication and comfort. The thoughtfully designed interior features a chef's kitchen outfitted with premium Bosch appliances, opening into a gracious dining area and an additional sitting space ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. A sunken living room with a fireplace creates a warm, inviting atmosphere and leads to a private, covered terrace perfect for outdoor dining. Additional highlights include hardwood floors throughout, high ceilings, and generously proportioned rooms. Located just moments from Greenwich Avenue, 25 W Elm offers exceptional amenities, including a full-time doorman, assigned parking, and private storage unit. Move-in ready and ideally situated this is downtown Greenwich living at its finest.
